# GoGeo Holidays

> > GoGeo Holidays specializes in Kerala tour packages from major Indian cities, featuring backwater cruises, hill stations, honeymoon getaways, and wellness experiences.

GoGeo Holidays is a travel operator offering customized Kerala tourism packages including houseboat stays in Alleppey and Kumarakom, hill station tours to Munnar and Wayanad, and seasonal monsoon travel experiences. The company provides tour packages from multiple departure cities across India with comprehensive pricing and itinerary planning.

## Key Topics

- Kerala tourism
- Backwater cruises and houseboat stays
- Munnar hill station
- Alleppey and Kumarakom
- Wayanad wildlife and nature
- Honeymoon packages
- Monsoon travel experiences
- Athirapally Waterfalls
- Budget travel planning
- Tour packages from major cities (Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad)
- Ayurveda and wellness retreats
- Kovalam and Varkala beaches
- Thekkady wildlife sanctuary
- Tour pricing and itinerary customization
